# AI MIDI Generator — Product and Technical Reference

## 1. Product overview
AI MIDI Generator is a browser-based AI-assisted music production application. It helps users turn musical ideas into editable multitrack MIDI arrangements, preview and refine those arrangements, and export material for use in a digital audio workstation (DAW).

- Landing page: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/
- Studio application: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/studio/
- Techno generator: https://midi-aigenerator.vercel.app/techno/

## 2. Core workflow
1. A user describes a musical direction or chooses custom musical settings.
2. The application requests structured musical material from an AI model through the Pollinations ecosystem.
3. The Studio parses and validates returned track data and prepares it for MIDI playback and export.
4. The user previews the arrangement, works with individual tracks or imports MIDI material.
5. The user exports MIDI for further production in a DAW. WAV audition/export tools are also available.

## 3. Musical controls and material
The Studio exposes controls for musical direction, including tempo, key, scale, mood, rhythmic complexity and section/structure choices. Exact options may change; consult the live Studio UI for the current list.

The application focuses on melodic and harmonic MIDI parts such as basslines, melodies, chords, arpeggios, plucks, keys, guitar, strings and pad textures. Do not assume every generation contains every track type.

## 4. Editing and import
The Studio includes track-level editing tools and supports importing an existing MIDI file. Users can use imported material as a starting point for further work and create or refine companion parts.

## 5. Preview and export
- MIDI preview is available in the Studio.
- MIDI export prepares material for compatible DAWs.
- WAV audition/export tools are available; consult the Studio UI for current options and any beta labels or limitations.

The application complements a DAW rather than replacing a complete production, sound-design or mixing environment.

## 6. AI models
The Studio offers model choices, including Standard and additional Pro options. Exact model names, providers and availability can change; the live Studio interface is authoritative.

## 7. Pollinations Pay and BYOP
The Studio does not provide built-in free generation credits. Generation requests use the user's own Pollinations Pollen through Pollinations Pay.

The user connects a Pollinations account through the Bring Your Own Pollen (BYOP) authorization flow and approves a budget. Some model choices may have different Pollen costs. Users should review the budget and current model pricing before generating.
Do not describe the product as offering a fixed number of free monthly generations or unlimited free generation.

## 8. Suno prompt tools
The Studio includes a Suno Prompt tool to help develop prompts for music generation. This is a prompt-authoring workflow and should not be confused with MIDI export or the core MIDI generation pipeline.

## 9. Technical overview
The public application is a browser-based web app with frontend JavaScript modules and serverless API routes. The Studio uses Tone.js for audio-related functionality and MIDI tooling for MIDI import/export and playback workflows. Implementation details may evolve; consult the repository for current source.

Repository: https://github.com/argyrisAEK/AI-MIDI-Generator

## 10. Scope boundaries
- The tool creates MIDI material and does not replace a full DAW.
- MIDI is editable after export in a compatible DAW.
- WAV tools are intended for preview/audition; consult the live UI for current capabilities and limitations.
- Mobile usability may differ from the desktop production workflow.
